compatibility_policy: Canonical lever IDs and the activation boundary are append-only; deprecate by metadata instead of renaming, deleting, or moving an ID used by a completed version.
version_policy: One primary lever and at most one necessary dependent lever; rsi-v0001 is the baseline-reset exception.
